supportTiers.name: Standard

tiers.name: Foundation
tiers.tagline: Managed readiness for one framework, with the Compliance Workspace and a monthly operating cadence.
tiers.audience: Startups and small teams preparing for a first SOC 2 Type I or an internal readiness review, who want a named readiness lead from day one.
features: Canonical Compliance Workspace with a readiness map for one framework, control owners, and evidence links
Control-owner and evidence-calendar administration
Six hours per month of managed compliance operations: monthly evidence-freshness and exception review, monthly risk and remediation working session
Up to five read-only evidence connectors with signed observation intake
Standard exports for customer and independent-evaluator review
Standard support and the published Service Level Objectives
notIncluded: Independent evaluator coordination beyond standard exports

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.tagline: Managed compliance operations across two frameworks with a biweekly operating rhythm.
tiers.audience: Scaling companies carrying SOC 2 Type II plus one adjacent framework.
features: Everything in Foundation
Up to two active frameworks with shared-control reuse
Twelve hours per month of managed compliance operations: biweekly evidence, remediation, risk, and owner review
Quarterly executive security and compliance review
Expanded customer-questionnaire and independent-evaluator coordination under the coordination agreement
Prioritized connector and evidence-source onboarding
Priority support with a 99.9% availability commitment
notIncluded: Weekly operating review and vCISO cadence

tiers.name: Scale
tiers.tagline: Multi-framework programs with a weekly operating review, executive cadence, and 24x7 critical support.

Twenty hours per month of managed compliance operations: weekly operating review plus a monthly executive / vCISO-style review with roadmap, risk register, and board pack
Bounded audit and readiness-room coordination with the independent evaluator
Quarterly operating-model and evidence-quality assessment
24x7 first response for P1 incidents
Custom data-processing and security addenda negotiated under the MSA
Dedicated onboarding and offboarding plan with data-return attestation
notIncluded: Third-party assessor, certification-body, QSA, or 3PAO fees
Any audit opinion, certificate, attestation, or authorization

sowPackages.name: Readiness Diagnostic
sowPackages.summary: A fixed-scope, fixed-fee diagnostic that produces a gap register, an owner map, and a phased remediation plan for one framework.
deliverables: Scoping memo naming the framework, criteria, systems, and people in scope
Gap register with severity, owner, and recommended remediation
Evidence inventory mapped to controls in the Compliance Workspace
Phased remediation plan with effort estimates and dependencies
assumptions: Customer provides a single accountable sponsor and access to the in-scope systems within five business days of the effective date
Interviews are scheduled within the first week
Findings are limited to the framework and systems named in the scoping memo
outOfScope: Remediation work, policy drafting, and tool configuration
Any audit, attestation, certification, or authorization
Systems, entities, or frameworks not named in the scoping memo

sowPackages.name: SOC 2 Readiness Implementation
sowPackages.summary: A fixed-fee implementation that takes a diagnosed gap register to evidence-backed readiness for a SOC 2 examination period.
deliverables: Control narratives and policy set aligned to the selected Trust Services Criteria
Configured evidence connectors and observation routing
Remediation tracking with weekly status and burn-down
Evidence package organized for handoff to the independent evaluator
Examination-period readiness checklist and cutover plan
assumptions: A Readiness Diagnostic or equivalent gap register exists before the start date
Customer engineering owners are available for a weekly working session
The independent evaluator is contracted directly by Customer
outOfScope: The SOC 2 examination itself and any opinion or report
Penetration testing and vulnerability assessment services
Frameworks beyond SOC 2 unless added by change order

sowPackages.name: Multi-Framework Readiness Program
sowPackages.summary: A program-level engagement that unifies controls, evidence, and owners across several frameworks while preserving framework-specific reviews.
deliverables: Unified control library with framework crosswalk and isolation rules
Program charter, RACI, and executive reporting cadence
Evidence architecture across connectors, observations, and retention classes
Framework-specific readiness checklists and evaluator handoff packages
Transition plan into managed compliance operations
assumptions: Executive sponsor and program manager are named before kickoff
Frameworks in scope are fixed in the scoping memo; additions are change orders
Authorization programs such as FedRAMP are scoped and priced separately
outOfScope: Assessor, certification-body, QSA, and 3PAO fees and their opinions
Authorization packages priced under a separate Statement of Work
Staff augmentation beyond the managed-operations allowance
